faqs.q: Do I need to pay a security deposit?
faqs.a: No! Elite One offers a zero-deposit policy on our luxury and exotic cars to make your rental process smooth and stress-free.

faqs.q: Is free delivery included across Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide complimentary delivery and pickup anywhere within Dubai (hotels, residences, or airports).

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept Cash, Credit/Debit Visa cards, Bank Transfers, PayPal, and Cryptocurrencies including USDT and Bitcoin.

faqs.q: What documents are required to rent?
faqs.a: For tourists, we require a valid Passport, International Driving Permit (IDP), and home country driving license. Residents need a UAE Driving License and Emirates ID.
